newsitem.title: USA: Stone Venepal (Celgar) assumes mill ownership.
newsitem.headline: Stone Venepal (Celgar) assumes mill ownership.

text.p: Stone Venepal (Celgar) Pulp Inc, a unit of Stone Container (Canada) Corp, said Friday it completed the transfer of the remaining 50 percent interest in the Celgar pulp mill in Castlegar, British Columbia, owned by CITIC B.C. Inc, an indirect subsidiary of China International Trust Investment Corp of Beijung, China.
Final terms and conditions regarding the transfer are expected to be resolved shortly.
Stone Venepal (Celgar) Pulp is 90 percent owned by Stone Container (Canada), a wholly owned subsidiary of Stone Container Corp.

The transfer will allow Stone Container to sell and market all of the northern bleached softwood kraft pulp that Celgar produces. It gives Stone access to new markets for this pulp, including Asia and other regions.
Stone Container also said it is actively negotiating with other parties interested in acquiring approximately half of Stone Container Canada's interest in Stone Venepal (Celgar) Pulp.
The sale would remove all of Stone Venepal (Celgar) Pulp's debt from Stone Container's consolidated balance sheet.
